history.sg_progress: As communicated earlier to the Board, UNSOS has established an integrated medical office that coordinates all medical logistic activities for the provision of medical support to AMISOM, including: (a) the identification of medical goods and service’s needs; (b) processing requisitions; (c) the distribution of items from Mogadishu to sectors; (d) the monitoring of the consumption of medical supplies; and (e) the analysis of historical data consumption for acquisition planning. The chief medical officer at UNSOS and the force medical officer at AMISOM conduct joint monthly teleconferences and videoconferences with AMISOM medical officers in the sectors to discuss ways to improve medical support. Additional measures already taken by UNSOS to improve procurement planning and contract management are reflected in the Administration’s response to the Board’s recommendation in paragraph 179 of its report.
